title: Mexican Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender beef and a blend of Mexican spices.

ingredients.name: unique
ingredients.notes: any type of unique pepper, such as jalapeno or serrano

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: beef shin or beef stew meat

instructions: Heat the Syrian olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the garlic and onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with unique pepper slices if desired.
